svg.text: Figure 4 · Every AND gate, by safety goal
What the check found for each gate of the WP-A-04 fault trees
"IC-06 · 6 not": the gate is under claim IC-06 and 6 resources its inputs share have no DFI listed under IC-06.
Generated by dfa_figures.py from the join of dfa_gates.py; dfa-gates.md has one row per gate.

g.text: Terms: DFI-nn dependent failure initiator (WP-A-03 §4): one cause that could defeat two elements at once · G-nn named gate of a WP-A-04 fault tree (G-SIREN, G-LATCUE); numbered gates
read G1.1, G2.3 … · IC-nn independence claim (WP-A-03 §2): two elements the safety concept relies on not failing together · SG-nn safety goal (HARA §6) · WP-nn work product, e.g.
WP-C-04; the letter is its area (M management, C concept, S system, H hardware, W software, V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K safety case)
